title: The Monkey and the Carpenter
logline: A curious monkey who has watched a carpenter all morning decides the work is easy, pulls out the wedge that holds a sawn log open, and the log snaps shut on his own tail.
moral: Do not meddle with work you do not understand; watching is not the same as knowing.
tone: Light slapstick with a kind heart: a comic build of overconfidence, one sharp shock, real sympathy for the trapped monkey, and a gentle, forgiving rescue.

beats.summary: The carpenter and his peaceful morning routine in front of the cottage.
The curious monkey watches from the tree and copies what he sees.
The wedge goes into the sawn gap: the key prop is planted.
The audience is shown what the wedge is for; the monkey only sees the sawing.
The carpenter leaves his tools and goes indoors: the yard is unguarded.
Overconfidence: this work looks easy, I can do it too.
He sits on the log and his tail drops into the gap, unnoticed.
The wedge moves a little, which only encourages him.
The wedge is out and the log snaps shut on his tail.
Trapped and in pain: every movement hurts more, so he freezes and cries.
The carpenter understands at a glance and chooses to help.
He opens the gap with a tool and frees the tail gently.
Back in the tree the monkey catches himself copying and stops: he watches from afar and touches nothing.

cast.name: the carpenter

cast.look: Stocky, kindly man: small white turban cap, short black beard and moustache, yellow tunic with rolled sleeves, brown apron with one pocket (the wedge lives there), bare forearms in skin tone. Scale 0.92.

cast.name: the curious monkey
cast.base: Library monkey unchanged, with new optional fields tailPath, tail pinch/kink and armLen

cast.name: the small bird (witness)
cast.look: Tiny red songbird that shares the branch, flees at the scream and returns for the last gag.

sets.description: World 1000 x 1230, ground y 900. Left third: forest edge (treeRow, hillTrees) and one big perch tree (trunk x 110, branch to the right with the perch at 215,540, leaf clumps that can be drawn in front of the monkey). Right edge: a cottage facade (x 820..1000, red roof, chimney, window at x 950, door at x 880 that opens 0..1 and shows a dim interior). Centre: open work ground. Sun on a keyed arc (dawn, morning, noon).

props.description: splitLog: big log lying along the ground, x 330..670, 120 thick, on two chocks, end rings on the right end. States: whole; chalk line; kerf 0..1 (how far the cut runs in from the right end); gap 0..1 (the upper half hinges up from the end of the kerf, about 34 units open at the right end when 1). Can also be drawn carried at an angle.
Small wooden wedge, 60 x 26, bright yellow with red end grain so it reads on the brown log; out 0..1 from the mouth of the gap; can be held in a hand, fly and bounce.
Hand saw: red handle, pale blade with a toothed lower edge; stroke offset along its length.
Wooden mallet: brown handle, yellow block head.
Iron pry bar (the "tool" of paragraph 7): dark blue-grey bar with a flattened, slightly hooked tip.
A finished plank door leaning on the cottage wall (three planks, two cross bars, ring handle).

scenes.summary: Morning in the yard between cottage and forest. The carpenter comes out, sits and builds a door and a table. Up in the tree a monkey watches and copies him.

scenes.summary: One day he brings a big log from the forest, drops it on two chocks, saws a gap into its end and taps a small wedge into the gap.

scenes.composition: Monkey works left to right, from his tree to the forbidden log, the cottage door always in the far right background as the threat. Thought cloud sits upper right, clear of his face. Final frame: his rump on the upper half near the open end, tail hanging down the camera side with its tip inside the dark gap.

actions.library: painPulse with rising radius on moves [118.1, 118.6, 119.1]

actions.action: Stops moving altogether: frozen stiff, eyes wet, lip trembling, one tear
actions.acting: wet true, tremble 1 unit, brow -0.6

actions.action: Turns only his eyes toward the cottage and lets out a long thin wail; the sound arcs travel across the yard to the window
actions.acting: head still, mouth small o; pleading
actions.library: gaze to the door; arcs moving source to listener

scenes.summary: The carpenter hears, runs back, understands at a glance, levers the gap open with a pry bar, lifts the tail out gently and steps back so the monkey can calm down.

camera.notes: Keys: 121.3-124.2 medium on door and window {x:860,y:720,zoom:1.7}; 124.28-125.9 whip pan left with the run to the two-shot {x:650,y:740,zoom:1.5} from twoShot(carpenterHead, monkeyHead); 132.4-137.8 push to {x:670,y:780,zoom:2.1} for the rescue; 138.58-140 pull out to {x:620,y:730,zoom:1.3} to show the respectful distance.

scenes.composition: Carpenter on the right at x 760 (kneeling at x 735 for the rescue), monkey on the log at x 600: both faces in frame throughout the rescue, monkey looking up, carpenter looking down. The stray wedge lies on the ground at about x 800 so his eyes can find it.

actions.action: In the window his head jerks up from the bowl, spoon in the air, one hand to his ear
actions.acting: eyes wide, chewing stops

actions.action: The wail arcs wash over the window; the spoon drops
actions.acting: he is already rising

actions.action: The door bangs open and he runs out, napkin still tucked in his collar
actions.acting: run: big amp, tip 0.15, arms pumping; dust on each step

actions.action: Whip pan left with him to the log
actions.acting: motion streaks for 4 frames

actions.action: Skids to a stop with a heel dust trail and a settle; a ! pops in the pause
actions.acting: sq 0.92 then up; eyes wide on the monkey

actions.action: Looks up at him with wet eyes and points weakly at his tail
actions.acting: pleading: brow -0.6, lip quiver, small tremble
actions.library: wet, handR IK toward the seam

actions.action: His eyes travel: the tail in the seam, then the wedge lying on the ground, then back to the monkey
actions.acting: three clean holds joined by quick eases

actions.action: A dotted line links the three things he looked at: wedge, seam, tail
actions.acting: the audience reads his deduction

actions.action: Shakes his head once with a small sigh, half a smile: not angry
actions.acting: brow -0.3, lids soften

actions.action: Shows the monkey an open calming palm, then picks the pry bar from the tool row
actions.acting: slow movements so as not to frighten him; the monkey shrinks back a little
actions.library: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp one hand; handR IK to the bar

actions.action: The bar glints as he kneels at the open end of the log
actions.acting: kneel with a settle

actions.action: Sets the bar tip in the seam and leans his weight on it
actions.acting: anticipation, then a steady push; jaw set
actions.library: handR IK on the bar end; tip 0.1

actions.action: The seam creaks open again: the upper half lifts
actions.acting: gap 0 to 0.8, creak lines

actions.action: Flinches and screws his eyes shut, bracing for more pain
actions.acting: lid 1, shoulders up, tremble

actions.action: Holding the bar down with one hand, slides the other under the tail
actions.acting: tongue tip out, eyes on the tail only

actions.action: Lifts the tail out slowly
actions.acting: slow ease over a full half second
actions.library: handL IK up; tailPath follows the hand

actions.action: The tail comes free: flattened, with a zigzag kink, throbbing red; he opens one eye, then both
actions.acting: relief floods in: long breath out, shoulders drop

actions.action: Lays the tail across the monkey lap; the monkey hugs it to his chest
actions.acting: gentle; a small nod
actions.library: handL IK; monkey handL/handR to the tail

actions.action: Eases the bar out (the seam closes softly), stands and backs away three steps, palms low and open
actions.acting: never turns his back; steps do not slide

actions.action: Pull out to show the space he has given
actions.acting: eased

actions.action: Breathing slows, the trembling fades, he blows on the tail tip; the carpenter crouches at a distance and waits
actions.acting: tremble decays to 0; two slow blinks; both gazes meet for a moment
actions.library: breathe slowing; tremble amplitude keyed down

scenes.summary: The monkey leaps back to his tree and nurses his tail. The carpenter goes back to work. This time the monkey does not copy him: he watches from far away and touches nothing. THE END.

camera.notes: Keys: 142.0-144.6 wide following the leap {x:420,y:660,zoom:1.15}; 145.06-148.3 medium on the branch {x:250,y:560,zoom:1.9}; 150.18-152.9 pan to the carpenter {x:660,y:760,zoom:1.5}; 153.54-156.9 back on the monkey {x:250,y:560,zoom:2.0}; 157.66-160 slow pull out to the full wide {x:500,y:640,zoom:1.0} and hold to the end.

scenes.composition: The opening diagonal returns: monkey high left, carpenter low right, but now the monkey is deeper in the leaves and further back on the branch. Keep the upper middle of the wide frame empty for THE END.

actions.action: In the pause: crouches on the log, eyes on the branch
actions.acting: anticipation; tail held in one hand

actions.action: Leaps from the log to the trunk and scrambles up to the branch, the sore tail trailing limp
actions.acting: stretch in flight; tail lags behind with no curl
actions.library: hop(log to trunk) + hop(trunk to branch); tailPath limp

actions.action: Lands on the branch: squash, the branch bobs, three leaves fall
actions.acting: landSquash then settle

actions.action: Shuffles back toward the trunk and sits
actions.acting: small, hunched (sq 0.93)

actions.action: Leaf clumps close in front of him so that only his face and the tail show
actions.acting: he pulls one clump closer like a blanket
actions.library: crown circles drawn after the monkey

actions.action: Cradles the kinked tail tip and blows on it; a small red throb answers each breath; he winces
actions.acting: wet eyes, lid 0.4, brow -0.5

actions.action: Down below, in the pause, he taps the wedge back into the log with one mallet tap: the gap opens again
actions.acting: the monkey flinches at the tap
actions.library: strike cycle hit 148.8; splitLog gap 0 to 1

actions.action: His eyes come up over the tail and look down at the yard
actions.acting: gaze along the old diagonal

actions.action: Pan down the eye line to the carpenter
actions.acting: eased

actions.action: Picks up the saw and sets it in the kerf
actions.acting: calm, unhurried; one glance up at the tree, a small smile
actions.library: handR IK; gaze to the tree

actions.action: Sawing resumes: the same easy rhythm as before
actions.acting: sawdust on each stroke

actions.action: By pure habit his free hand starts to make the sawing movement
actions.acting: eyes on the saw, hand moving on its own
actions.library: handR keyed to the stroke phase

actions.action: The tail throbs; he looks at his moving hand, then at the tail, and freezes
actions.acting: realisation: eyes wide, hand stops in mid-air

actions.action: Shakes his head fast and stuffs the hand under his arm
actions.acting: firm little frown; lesson learned
actions.library: head shake = sin over 0.6 s on dir or x; handR IK to armpit

actions.action: NOPE! pops beside the branch
actions.acting: small, clear of his face

actions.action: Slow pull out to the full wide yard
actions.acting: eased over 2.3 s

actions.action: The dotted eye line from the opening returns between monkey and carpenter, longer now
actions.acting: holds one second

actions.action: Sinks a little deeper into the leaves, hugging the tail
actions.acting: only eyes, hands and tail show

actions.action: The bird flies back and lands boldly on the mallet handle in the tool row
actions.acting: it looks up at the monkey as if to invite him

actions.action: Looks at the tools, then shows both palms and leans away: no thank you
actions.acting: head turned aside, lids shut, tail safely in his lap

actions.action: THE END in the empty upper middle; the carpenter keeps sawing, the monkey blows once more on his tail and blinks
actions.acting: held ending; nothing new starts

subtitles.ar: في قرية صغيرة، كان هناك نجار يعمل قرب الغابة. | كل صباح، يجلس أمام بيته ويصنع أبوابًا وطاولات من الخشب. | وكان قرد فضولي يراقبه من فوق شجرة قريبة.
subtitles.en: In a small village, a carpenter worked near the forest. | Every morning he sat outside his house making doors and tables from wood. | A curious monkey watched him from a nearby tree.

subtitles.ar: ذات يوم، وضع النجار قطعة خشب كبيرة على الأرض. | أراد أن يقسمها إلى نصفين، فاستخدم منشارًا حتى فتح شقًّا في وسطها. | ثم وضع قطعة صغيرة من الخشب داخل الشق.
subtitles.en: One day, the carpenter placed a large log on the ground. | He wanted to split it in two, so he used a saw to make a gap in its middle. | Then he put a small piece of wood inside the gap.

subtitles.ar: كانت القطعة الصغيرة تُبقي النصفين متباعدين، حتى يستطيع النجار متابعة عمله بسهولة. | وبعد وقت قصير، شعر النجار بالتعب. | ترك أدواته وذهب إلى البيت ليأكل ويستريح.
subtitles.en: The small piece kept the two halves apart so the carpenter could continue his work easily. | After a while, he grew tired. | He left his tools and went inside to eat and rest.

subtitles.ar: نزل القرد من الشجرة، واقترب من الخشب. | قال في نفسه: «رأيت النجار يعمل طوال الصباح. | يبدو هذا العمل سهلًا، ويمكنني أن أفعل مثله!» | ثم جلس على القطعة الكبيرة.
subtitles.en: The monkey climbed down from the tree and approached the log. | “I have watched the carpenter all morning,” he thought. | “This work looks easy. I can do it too!” | Then he sat on the large piece of wood.

subtitles.ar: نظر القرد إلى القطعة الصغيرة داخل الشق، ولم يفهم لماذا وضعها النجار هناك. | مدّ يده وأمسك بها، ثم أخذ يسحبها بكل قوته. | تحركت القطعة قليلًا، فزاد القرد سحبه.
subtitles.en: The monkey looked at the small piece in the gap and did not understand why the carpenter had put it there. | He reached out and pulled it with all his strength. | It moved a little, so he pulled harder.

subtitles.ar: وفجأة خرجت القطعة الصغيرة من مكانها، وأغلق الخشب على ذيل القرد! | صرخ القرد وحاول أن يقفز، لكنه لم يستطع. | كان ذيله عالقًا، وكلما تحرك شعر بألم أكبر.
subtitles.en: Suddenly, the small piece came out, and the log closed around the monkey’s tail! | The monkey cried out and tried to jump away, but he could not. | His tail was trapped, and every movement hurt more.

subtitles.ar: سمع النجار الصراخ، فعاد مسرعًا. | رأى القرد فوق الخشب، وفهم ما حدث. | استخدم أداة ليفتح الشق من جديد، ثم أخرج ذيل القرد بحذر، وابتعد عنه حتى يهدأ.
subtitles.en: The carpenter heard the cries and hurried back. | He saw the monkey on the log and understood what had happened. | He used a tool to open the gap again, carefully freed the monkey’s tail, and stepped back to let him calm down.

subtitles.ar: قفز القرد إلى الشجرة، وجلس بين الأغصان وهو يتألم. | نظر إلى النجار الذي عاد إلى عمله، لكنه هذه المرة لم يحاول تقليده. | بقي يراقب من بعيد، دون أن يلمس الأدوات.
subtitles.en: The monkey leaped into the tree and sat among the branches, still hurting. | He watched the carpenter return to his work, but this time he did not try to imitate him. | He stayed at a distance and did not touch the tools.

ending.description: Full wide of the yard as at the start: the carpenter sawing at the wedged log, the bird on the mallet handle, the monkey deep in the leaves hugging his tail with his palms turned away from the tools. THE END appears at 162.4 in the empty upper middle and holds to 165.29; only idle motion (sawing, a blink, one breath on the tail) continues.

new_assets.name: villager
new_assets.description: Reuses the planned 'villager' person variant (owner base, turban or cap, beard, tunic colour) and adds the costume preset 'carpenter': white turban cap, short beard, yellow tunic, brown apron with pocket, rolled sleeves.
new_assets.implementation: Wrap person({kind:'owner'}) : draw the owner body with recoloured tunic (flat yellow, red dot shading), replace the nightcap by a turban cap (two stacked ellipses), add a beard arc under the mouth, and draw the apron as a rounded brown rect over the torso after the body and before the arms so the arm IK still works. All existing person fields (handL/handR, aL/aR, PERSON_HANDS, wink, walk fields, lean) pass through.

new_assets.name: person kneel / sit
new_assets.description: Reuses the planned person pose fields sit 0..1 (on the stool, P1) and kneel 0..1 (at the log for the rescue, P7).
new_assets.implementation: sit: lower the hips by about 60 units, draw thighs horizontal toward the facing side and shins down; kneel: lower the hips by about 80, one shin flat on the ground behind, the other knee up. Blend linearly from the standing leg geometry; torso, head and arms unchanged so arm IK and gaze keep working.

new_assets.name: monkey tailPath / pinch / armLen
new_assets.description: Optional monkey fields: tailPath (array of points or a function giving the tail centre line, so the tail can hang down the side of the log, lie in the gap, go taut, trail limp, be lifted by a hand), tailClip (a seam line below which the tail is hidden), tailKink (0..1 zigzag and flattening near a given point) and armLen (arm length multiplier up to 1.5 for the long reach to the wedge). Defaults keep the current look.
new_assets.implementation: When tailPath is present draw the tail as a thick stroked polyline through the points (black outline stroke, then fur stroke, then the ring bands at equal arc lengths as in the current tail) instead of the fixed curl; tailClip is a ctx.clip rectangle above the seam; tailKink offsets three points sideways and narrows the stroke. armLen scales both arm segments in the existing two-segment IK. Without these fields the monkey draws exactly as now (regression test must stay identical).

new_assets.name: villageYard
new_assets.description: Village cottage yard at a forest edge: cottage facade with an opening door and a window, perch tree with a branch and foreground leaf clumps, forest row, keyed sun. Reusable for any village or craftsman story.
new_assets.implementation: Bake the static layer: sky({preset}), hillTrees, treeRow limited to x < 420, ground, tree(ctx, 110, 900, opts with a right-hand branch). Cottage as a new sets function in the islandHut look: cream wall rect with blue dots, red roof polygon, chimney, window, door as a brown rect whose width scales with 1 - open and a navy interior behind it. Draw the leaf clumps (crown circles) again after the monkey as occluders. Sun and cloud drawn live.

new_assets.name: splitLog (with wedge)
new_assets.description: The log with chalk line, kerf, hinged gap and wedge states described in props; the heart of this story.
new_assets.implementation: Lower half: rounded brown rect with bark dashes and end rings (ellipse arcs) on the right. Upper half: same shape, rotated about the hinge point (the inner end of the kerf) by gap * 0.1 rad; the opening between them is filled dark navy. kerf sets the hinge x. Wedge: a yellow triangle with a red end face translated by out along the gap axis. Dust and creak lines from dustBurst and short strokes. All parameters are pure functions of t.

new_assets.name: carpenterTools (saw, mallet, pry bar, stool, door, table)
new_assets.description: The small carpentry props listed in props, drawn as one module.
new_assets.implementation: Each is 3 to 6 flat shapes with a black outline (rects, a toothed polygon for the saw edge, a ring for the door handle). Each takes x, y, rot, s so a hand target can carry it.

new_assets.name: painPulse
new_assets.description: A red throb at a point: one or two expanding rings plus three small stars, with a size parameter so pain can visibly grow.
new_assets.implementation: Rings: stroked circles with radius and alpha from pulse(t, t0, 0.5); stars: 4-point polygons at seeded angles (K.rng). size multiplies the radius.

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud
new_assets.description: Reuses the planned generic thought cloud large enough to stage action in (the memory of the carpenter working, then the monkey fantasy).
new_assets.implementation: cloud() outline at a given box with three lead-in bubbles, a clip to its interior and a callback that draws the inner mini scene at scale; keep inner figures at 110 px or more on screen.

implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; world 1000 x 1230, ground y 900; set LIFE.t = t each frame for blinks; apply shake inside the panel clip only.
One timeline object CUE built from timing.json word starts; every action time in this plan is the listed word start or an offset from it. The SNAP is on the start of the word at 105.78.

Log state is three keyed scalars: kerf(t), gap(t), wedgeOut(t). gap: 0 until 32.46, 0.35 by 33.4, 1.0 after the taps at 40.3 and 40.7, small dips at 44.1 and 77.4, 0.94 at 95.8, stepping down to about 0.8 by 100.4, held until 105.78, then 0 in 3 frames; 0.8 from 133.84 to 138.6, 0, then 1 again at 148.8.

Monkey seat on the log: (600, 780), dir 1. Tail in the gap at about (650, 815). Wedge head at (700, 815). Carpenter work spot x 760, kneeling spot x 735. Stray wedge rests at about (800, 892) from 104.9 until he picks it up off screen before 148.8.
Use hop + landSquash for every monkey move on the ground (the Library monkey is a sitting figure, as in The Monkey and the Turtle); use walk + footfalls for every carpenter move so feet never slide.
The dotted eye line at 17.24 and 158.3 uses the same code so the ending mirrors the opening.
Lettering (14 items including THE END) sits in the upper band of the panel, never over a face; no dashes.
Sound: only the listed effects, all in narration pauses, SND master 0.6. Saw strokes, the snap and the scream are visual only.
New drawings are built in the story first; move them to Library (villager carpenter preset, villageYard, splitLog, tools, painPulse, monkey tail fields) after approval, then run the regression test.
warnings: The SNAP at 105.78 has no narration pause around it (words run continuously from 102.48 to 109.26), so by the sound rule it is silent and carried by the picture (flash, dust, shake, lettering). Open question for the user: allow one very short, quiet thud exactly on the word boundary at 105.78?

Liberty in the staging: the split is drawn as a horizontal mouth opening at the end of the log (upper half hinging up) so the gap, the wedge and the tail all read from the side. A real rip cut would be vertical and invisible in a side view.
The monkey reach to the wedge needs longer arms than the current IK (new armLen). Fallback if it looks wrong: seat him at the very end of the log with his legs hanging either side of the wedge.
The Library monkey has no walk cycle; ground travel is by hops and the climb by two hops plus a trunk slide. If a real climb is wanted it is an extra pose.
The single LATER card falls at 50.9 (before "after a short while") and overlaps the first two words of that sentence for about 0.6 s of picture only; subtitles stay visible.
The carpenter tapping the wedge back in at 148.8 and the bird on the mallet are staging additions, not narrated; they do not contradict the script.
